description: Returns the two-hourly temperature, wind speed, and wind direction shown in the hourly view of the forecast page's weather by elevation grid, for one day in the free forecast window, with local times, ISO timestamps, the time zone, and the chosen elevation. Takes a date from the route's visible days and an optional elevation band of base, mid, or summit. Informational only.

activity.description: Optional activity mode for the route forecast. Accepted values are the route's activities entries from search_objectives. When omitted, the route's default visible activity is used.

date.description: Day to return, as YYYY-MM-DD, from the days in the free forecast window.

elevation_band.description: Optional elevation band for the hourly temperature and wind: base, mid, or summit. The forecast page opens on summit, which is the default.

slug.description: Public objective slug returned by search_objectives.
